questions.explanation:
(a) 1s2 2s2 Be

(b) 1s2 2s2 2p4 O

(c) 1s2 2s2 2p3 N

(d) 1s2 2s2 2p1 B

The ionization enthalpy order is

B < Be < O < N

Be has more IE compared to B due to extra stability & N has more IE compared to oxygen due to extra stability.

Hence, N 1402 kJ/mol

O 1314 kJ/mol

B 801 kJ/mol

Be 899 kJ/mol
